what: A small 240×150 video window at the center of the pinned stage grows to fill the screen (100vw×100vh) over 2s power1.out, .5s after the section top edge touches the top of the screen (not scrub), and the sentences on both sides move out by one share (xPercent ∓100), the left one to the left and the right one to the right, vanishing over 1s power2.out after the same .5s. When scrolling back above the section, the window shrinks over 1.5s and the sentences return over 1s after .5s. The stage stays pinned for the section height (default 300svh)

options.back: Seconds to shrink when going back, default 1.5
options.side: Seconds for the text to drop out, default 1 — curve power2.out
options.min: Applied only under this media condition, default (min-width: 1025px) — otherwise the window stays at its css size (default full)
options.--fx-travel: Distance to descend while the stage is pinned (css), default 200svh
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Growing window (required) — video or photo inside
options.[data-fx-part=left]·[data-fx-part=right]: Sentence to exit to the sides (optional)

from.where: index.html .brk (pin where a small window video fills the screen) — original top-break: onEnter 240×150 → 100svw×100svh 2s power1.out delay .5, text xPercent ∓100 1s power2.out, onLeaveBack 1.5s

note: The original pins with ScrollTrigger pin (pinSpacing false) — same behavior, so it is pinned with sticky (so it doesn’t break inside inner scroll panels)
